description: Creates structure groups with the Construction Stage Wizard plugin's group builder: pick a scope of elements, split it by rules (slice along X/Y/Z into n segments or at cuts, by section, material, element type, thickness, id ranges, existing groups), name them from a template, and resolve clashes with existing groups by policy. Typical use: segments of a deck for staged construction, e.g. rules [{kind:'slice', axis:'X', mode:'count', count:8, cuts:[]}] with naming {template:'Seg_{SLICE}'}. Previews unless apply: true; the write keeps a snapshot for stages_undo.

apply.description: Write to CIVIL NX. Only after the user approved the preview.

confirmPlanHash.description: planHash from the approved preview; the write is refused if the plan differs.

naming.description: template with tokens {INDEX}, {SLICE}, {SECTION}, {MATERIAL}, {TYPE}…; prefix, suffix, pad, start.

policy.description: What to do when a group name already exists.

rules.description: Applied together (every combination becomes a group): {kind:'slice', axis:'X'|'Y'|'Z', mode:'count'|'cuts', count, cuts:[coords]}, {kind:'section'}, {kind:'material'}, {kind:'type'}, {kind:'thickness'}, {kind:'idRange', ranges:[{label, text}]}, {kind:'existingGroup', groups:[names]}.

typeFilter.description: Element types to keep (BEAM, TRUSS, PLATE, SOLID…); empty = all.

name: stage_groups
title: Construction Stage Wizard — structure groups
